chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

When death came to my father عليه السلام, he said: 'O Jaʿfar, I enjoin you to treat my companions well.' I said: 'May I be sacrificed for you, by Allah, I will leave them such that a man among them may be in a city and not need to ask anyone.'

key_terms.أُوصِيكَ: I enjoin you; I give you a directive or bequest
key_terms.الْمِصْرِ: the city; an inhabited center or locality
key_terms.الْوَفَاةُ: death; the approach of a person's final moments
key_terms.بِأَصْحَابِي: regarding my companions; concerning those associated with and following the Imam
key_terms.جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ: may I be made your ransom; an expression of devotion and reverence
key_terms.يَسْأَلُ: he asks; seeks help or knowledge from another

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام instruct Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام regarding his companions?
ai.summary: This hadith records a final instruction from the father of Abū ʿAbdillāh Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام concerning care for his companions. It highlights the Imam’s concern for his community and Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq’s commitment to nurturing them in a way that would make them intellectually and practically self-sufficient.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the death presented itself to my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>! I<sup>asws</sup> bequeath you<sup>asws</sup> to be good with my<sup>asws</sup> companions’. I said, ‘May I<sup>asws</sup> be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I<sup>asws</sup> shall educate them (to the extent that), and the man from them would happen to be in the city, so he would not (need to) ask anyone (to know anything)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.

“When myfather was about to leave this world he said, “O Ja‘far, I recommend you to be good to my companions.” I then said, “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, by Allah, I will educated them as such that in any city where any of them would live he would not need to ask others for knowledge (of religion).”
